items.item_text: 1 year of administrative support experience in a healthcare, medical office, ambulatory care, or patient service environment.
Experience in a ophthalmology practice or specialty medical office setting.
1 year of experience with patient registration, appointment scheduling, and insurance verification.

The Department of Ophthalmology's Cornea & Uveitis clinic is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support daily clinic operations and deliver excellent patient service. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Collect co-pays and process patient payments
Track status of patients' test or imaging
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing using proper grammar and professional etiquette.
Ability to prioritize tasks, exercise sound judgment, work independently with minimal supervision, and adapt to frequent interruptions in a fast-paced environment.
Working knowledge of medical terminology, insurance benefits, referral processes, and authorization procedures.
Ability to verify insurance eligibility, obtain authorizations, and communicate financial responsibilities to patients.
